threads.body: The util test environment installs `[wrapt]` and gets `opentelemetry-instrumentation` through `test_deps`, so it does not exercise the new base-only installation. The added tests check optional-module import errors, but would miss a core API import that accidentally requires either removed dependency. Add a fresh-process smoke test that blocks both dependency imports, imports the core APIs, and completes an invocation, following the [test requirement](AGENTS.md#guidelines).
